scope: Local prepared AI demo and actual teacher-to-learner course publication in the in-app browser

flows.name: PowerPoint file chooser
flows.result: Bundled PPTX selected from disk, recognized by its contents, and returned six cards.

flows.name: Prepared lesson formats
flows.result: PDF, PowerPoint, audio, video and captions each returned six cards with passed source checks.

flows.name: Flashcard controls
flows.result: Answer reveal, quotation/location display, and Got it / Next worked. Video evidence included clip and original timestamps.

flows.name: Syllabus side preview
flows.result: Shared course-info view showed three objectives, two meeting entries, twelve session topics and recorded authoring attribution. Updated syllabus and field mapping rendered.

flows.name: Course mapping export preview
flows.result: Parsed the displayed JSON: humanReview pending, three objectives, two meetings, 36 citations and gpt-6-astra attribution. Save-file link present.

flows.name: Evaluation
flows.result: Research figures remained separate from explicitly unmeasured app-specific savings and educational accuracy.

flows.name: Teacher syllabus publication
flows.result: Actual review and apply flow populated the course. Existing dates 2026-09-17 through 2027-01-15 and grading weights 40/30/30 were preserved.

flows.name: Independent Student A session
flows.result: Student A saw the published syllabus fields and authoring metadata while the other tab remained Teacher.

flows.name: Course lesson publication
flows.result: Prepared PDF plus six study cards published together. Publish remained disabled after five acknowledgements and enabled after six.

flows.name: Learner course player
flows.result: Student A opened the new study set; answer, PDF page/slide evidence, source filename and gpt-6-astra/xhigh authoring record were visible.

flows.name: Navigation
flows.result: Teacher could return from the course to the dashboard, open AI before/after, and return to LMS without losing the account or published course.

limitations: Review acknowledgements were synthetic workflow testing, not independent instructor certification.
Prepared results replay saved outputs; no live provider calls, API-equivalence claim or production SSO acceptance.
No full manual device/accessibility matrix, native playback or long-duration browser-memory test.
This pass checked the export preview and download link, not a newly saved download.

The file-chooser tool took longer than its requested timeout; the first server session stopped at its 20-minute safety cutoff and was restarted. Do not interpret that tool wait as measured application processing time.
No application code changes or automated-suite rerun in this pass; the latest full suite remains the October 16 attribution run.
